test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the approximate angle between the two hands of a clock (hour hand and minute hand) when the time is 8:45 ?
solution:
Given time: 8:45

Formula used: Angle = |30H - (11/2)M|

Where, M = minutes and H = hours

Here, M = 45, H = 8

Therefore,

Angle = |30 × 8 - (11/2) × 45|

= |240 - (495/2)|

= |240 - 247.5|

= |-7.5| = 7.5°

The approximate angle between the two hands is 7°.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
